[5:40PM] #Agege #PenCinema #TrafficUpdate 

Smooth movement is observed from Fumec inward Acme junction down to Metal Box. Similarly, Ijaye Road, both inbound and outbound from Odo Eran connecting Oba Ogunji, is experiencing appreciable traffic flow.

Travel along Oba Akran, from the Dangote U-turn inward Mobil Ashade and continuing down to Akilo, is moving at a fast pace. There's also good movement from Guinness inward Akanni Doherty, with only minor delays reported at Mangoro Ashade due to traffic light alternations.

Further along, Capitol inward Oniwaya junction down to Alfa Nla is also maintaining a fast pace. On the Old Ipaja Road, from Okekoto inward Shofunde, Agbotikiyo, and continuing down to NYSC, traffic conditions are favorable.

The Old Abeokuta Road from Isokoko inward Total (underneath the bridge) is currently busy due to traffic alternation and commuter activities. However, traffic connecting Nitel down to Oko Oba is generally moving at a fast pace, with a minor delay noted at Abattoir, also attributed to traffic alternation.

Currently, there are no reported impediments or major obstructions in these areas, and men are actively present at key locations. 

#FollowLASTMA
